description: This is a source code file for an Android app written in Kotlin. It defines a HomeActivity class which constructs the TV home screen UI, including a top menu with focus animations, several content rails with focus behaviors, and click handlers for navigation. The class manages UI setup, focus interactions, and opens a ContentInfo screen with sample content data when items are selected.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Android activity class representing the TV home screen, setting up UI components such as top menu and content rails with focus interaction and navigation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up UI components.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu buttons with focus animations and click navigation.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Instantiates and populates the horizontal content rails with focus behaviors and click/keypress handlers.

methods.name: openContentInfo
methods.description: Creates a ContentItem with sample data and navigates to the ContentInfoActivity to display content details.
